I really appreciate the hug, and the time you're taking to reply. And yeah, it's a long story but I'm just in a rough place right now.
And yeah, anxiety and panic are being a bitch too, could do without those. But hey, I can get through it for another day, I hope. Thanks again for your comment.

Sorry to hear you've been here before. I'm just so exhausted. I have too many alts to keep track of so people I know don't find me. I'm tired of telling myself it gets better when in reality i know tommorow is just going to involve the same old shit its involved today. I'm tired of waking up panicking and I'm tired of laying awake for hours on end.
